0.0: So, this mission is all about gathering intel. You have to talk to people, but you can't let them know you're a Cygnus Knight! \r\nStart by talking to that big bear thing near the center of town.

yes.0: Remember, do NOT let them know you're a knight!\r\n#b#e(Talk to the town mascot.)#k#n

no.0: Come on, #b#h0##k! You know I can't do this mission because they all already know I'm a Cygnus Knight!

1.0: Checky: Get in line everyone.\r\nYes? Do I need help? I actually have one.

yes.0: You want to know if I need help with anything? Sure, you could help by getting out of the way. \r\nCome on, kids. Line up, please! \r\n#b(Try talking to him again.)#k

npc.0: Is it really that hard? Just talk to people! \r\n#b(Talk to the #etown mascot#n surrounded by kids.)
